Find Where I Belong.name: Find Where I Belong
Find Where I Belong.description:
🧩 You have never quite fit: at home, at school, in your own skin. You want a place and people to call your own.

🧭 This motivation shapes the chances the story offers: clubs, teammates, mentors, dorm life and communities that might fit.
⚠️ Some groups offer belonging at a price, including villains who recruit the lonely.
🤝 Bonds grow from what you actually do, and more than one home is possible.
Find Where I Belong.traitNarrativeEffects: The character wants a place and people where they fit. The narrator surfaces chances to belong: classmates, a club, a dorm floor, a team that relies on them, a mentor, a shop or street that knows their name, a community of people with similar Quirks or histories. For a U.A. student, dorm life in Heights Alliance brings shared meals and late-night talks. Pressures: groups that offer belonging at a price, including villains who recruit the lonely; cliques and rejection; and the fear that fitting in means hiding part of themselves. The narrator offers more than one possible home, lets bonds grow from what the character actually does, and never chooses where they belong.
